items.title: An Action you can't pay is faded; several costs fit beside the name
items.do: Sylwen in combat: spend AP until 1 is left; look at Quick Shots (2 AP) in the HUD. Durgan: open the HUD's Basic tab on a small window.
items.expect: Quick Shots' line is faded (still clickable: the roll dialog warns). Shove, Relocate and Haul write their costs "1" "2" "3 AP" (Reaction Actions "1" "2R"), so their names aren't squished.

items.title: Attribute DCs: the roll dialog says "Body DC"
items.do: Durgan: Shove a Goblin Sneak; Kaela: Trip the Orc Warrior with Instinct.
items.expect: the roll dialog reads "Body +N vs. Body DC" (Kaela: "vs. the same Attribute's DC"), the card the same; the DC is 11 + the target's Attribute, shown as "Body DC (Goblin Sneak): 11 + ..."; the sheet's tiles read "Body DC" and so on.

items.title: A Doomed roll counts as 5 Banes; "Engaged with" names whom
items.do: Sylwen: shoot an enemy adjacent to her (Engaged: Doomed), once alone, once with 2 Boons added by hand; then shoot a Goblin that is adjacent to Kaela too.
items.expect: alone, Doomed (extra Banes subtract nothing); with 2 Boons a normal roll at −3. Shooting the Goblin beside Kaela, the Goblin's tile says "Engaged with Kaela" (1 Field Bane), distinct from your own "You are Engaged"; a Goblin adjacent only to Sylwen shows no such Bane.

items.title: An Immobilized creature's token can't be dragged, on its turn or not
items.do: Ogre Chieftain: Immobilized by Aveline's Binding Light; during a combat, drag its token on its own turn and on someone else's; then Alt-drag it (GM).
items.expect: both drags are refused with "Immobilized and can't move: Break Free (1 AP) first"; the Alt-drag moves it as Forced Movement.

items.title: A line that only touches a creature gives no cover; a Prone or dead one gives none
items.do: Sylwen shoots the Orc Warrior on an exact diagonal with a Goblin Sneak beside the line, its corner touching it (Show cover on). Then put the Goblin where the line crosses its square, then make it Prone, then dead.
items.expect: the corner touch gives no cover; crossing its square gives Low cover (1 Field Bane); Prone or dead, none.

items.title: Rime Strike's Ice Pillar: one "1 AP" in the HUD, its square clicked on the map
items.do: Aveline: look at Rime Strike in the HUD; use it (Power mode) on an Orc Warrior; on a Tier 2 or 3 Apply the damage; click one of the outlined squares. Once press Cancel instead.
items.expect: the HUD shows one "1 AP" stamp (not one per mode); the bar has only its text and Cancel; a click places the pillar (its Defense = 11 + her Power Modifier); Cancel places none. The other pick bars keep their buttons.
